subject: Pipeline sanitation standup — quick claim + close-date asks
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: finance-ops@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Pipeline sanitation standup — quick claim + close-date asks

Team — kicking off a short "sanitation" standup for Brightwell and a few other late-cycle accounts that look stalled in SFDC. Finance asked for cleaner commit visibility by EOD Wednesday so we can finalize the Q4 forecast. TL;DR asks below.

What I attached: a small export with 23 deals flagged by finance as >45 days unchanged (file: 20261114-stale-opps-export.csv) plus a one-pager playbook.

Please do the following by EOD Wednesday (11/18):
- Claim: Reply to this thread with any deals you own from the export (I highlighted likely owners in the sheet).
- Update Stage: Move to the correct stage or add a clear next-step milestone (no vague "Negotiation" placeholders).
- Close-date sanity: If the deal is pushed beyond Q4, mark the expected month and add a short justification in the SFDC notes.
- Evidence: If finance needs proof of a committed close, upload a single artifact (email, LOI, calendar event) to the Deal > Files and paste the link in a comment.

Quick priorities in the sheet: Brightwell Health (highlighted) — two deals with mismatched close months, and one deal showing an "On Hold" stage but with recent activity in email.

Why: Forecast integrity. We cannot push numbers to leadership with unknowns. The ask is not to force closes — it's to surface intent and evidence so finance can bucket risk properly.

If you can’t take any items, say so so we can reassign before the end of day. I’ll run a sync on Thursday morning if there are unresolved items.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, North America Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20261114-stale-opps-export.csv (CSV, 23 rows) ; sanitation-playbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pipeline sanitation standup — quick claim + close-date asks

Vanessa — thanks for the clear asks. I pulled the export and will claim the two Brightwell deals flagged with the same owner tag (BSW-298 and BSW-301). Action plan:
- BSW-298: I'll ping Brian Tan (Brightwell) this morning to confirm whether they expect legal to sign before 11/30 or if they're pushing to Jan. I already have the last email thread with Brian in the deal files, will attach the calendar invite if legal confirms.
- BSW-301: There was a change request outstanding — scheduling a contract sync with contracts@brightwell.com for Tuesday. If contracts confirm timing, I'll update close-date.

I will update the SFDC stage to "Commit: Awaiting Signature" for 298 (with comment pointing to the email) and add schedule evidence to 301 after the contracts sync.

Karthik
Sr. Account Executive

- Karthik: if you get a verbal from Brian today, mark BSW-298 as Q4 close and upload the calendar invite or confirmation email. Finance will take it as "probable" instead of "commit" if no evidence exists.
- Jonas: noted — thanks for the triage.
- Priya: I didn’t see your claim yet; if you’re tied up, please reply with which deals (if any) you can pick up or we’ll reassign tomorrow.
